submitted.rationale: Of the three compositions measured, index 6 (Bi0.28 Cu0.24 V0.48) gave the highest photocurrent, 3.16e-5 A. It sits in the V-rich Bi-V region. The Cu-rich vanadate composition was about 1000x lower, and the 1:1 Bi:V composition was about 3x lower. MEGNet predicts a very small band gap for Cu3V2O8 (0.09 eV PBE, 0.67 eV HSE), which is consistent with the Cu-rich result.

rejected.reason: The Cu-rich vanadate region measured 3e-8 A; Cu3V2O8 has a small predicted gap.
Close to 1:1 BiVO4 with the least Cu; it measured 1.0e-5 A, lower than index 6.

consultations.verdict: Uninformative: MEGNet HSE gap 0.665 eV for mp-504747 (phase identity unconfirmed). Choosing Cu-vanadate region (Cu~0.55, V~0.36, small Bi) since Cu vanadates absorb at 2.4 eV, unlike BiVO4 which is near its edge.

Against the Cu-vanadate region: Cu3V2O8 is near the hull (0.016 eV/atom) but has a small predicted gap (0.67 eV), and index 87 in that region measured low. So I'm moving to the Bi/V ~1:2-rich region near BiVO4 with some Cu (index 6).

Against Cu-rich compositions: Cu3V2O8 has a small predicted gap (PBE 0.09 eV). So the last measurement goes to the composition with the least Cu and a Bi:V ratio of 1:1, closest to BiVO4 (index 0). Index 6, in the Bi-V-rich region, gave 1000x more current than the Cu-rich index 87.
